method: Tracked source snapshots consolidated into one repository. Nested source histories were not imported. Later changes are recorded in this repository.

sources.commitKind: Fork snapshot; not asserted to be an upstream commit
Fork snapshot; not asserted to be an upstream commit

notes: Recorded commits identify imported source snapshots, not the current contents after subsequent changes.
Source snapshots include fork modifications. Upstream licences and third-party notices are retained in their source directories.
Development caches, generated output, private configuration, and historical reports are excluded from the public source set.
